data: All examples are hypothetical model calculations; no market data or random sampling.
units: Prices per one underlying unit; time in years with 365 days; UI volatility and rates in %, internal decimals; IV shifts in percentage points.

labs.title: Payoff vs profit
labs.method: Signed intrinsic payoff and profit after the user-specified premium; no financing or fees.

labs.title: Normal vs lognormal
labs.method: Analytic risk-neutral GBM terminal density and a Normal/ABM endpoint with equal mean and normal volatility S0*sigma; tails cropped only for chart display.

labs.title: Binomial tree
labs.method: CRR up=exp(sigma*sqrt(dt)), down=1/up, q=(exp(r*dt)-down)/(up-down); backward induction and American exercise max. No dividend.

labs.title: Convergence
labs.method: European CRR versus BSM Call/Put with identical parameters, prices at steps 5,10,...,N.

sources: Existing lesson equations and independent algebraic/benchmark tests.
implementation: Original implementation. No upstream source code copied. Existing React, KaTeX, SVG chart controls and locally bundled fonts reused.
